decisive_items: recurrent stage IIIC papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary
BRCA-1 mutation (c. 2563C > T p. Q855*) at 33.3% MAF
response.rationale: R7 best integrates the primary ovarian serous adenocarcinoma with the somatic BRCA1 mutation detected on tumor/ctDNA, making it the most specific diagnosis. R8 captures the histology but omits the molecular driver; other candidates are broader or describe treatment resistance/metastatic pattern rather than the diagnosis.

rejected.why: Ovarian cancer is too broad and omits serous histology and BRCA1 mutation.
BRCA-1 mutation-related cancer is less specific than R7 and the germline-negative context makes 'related' vague.
Paclitaxel/carboplatin resistance is a treatment inference, not a diagnosis, and not directly confirmed.
Metastatic cancer describes spread, not the primary diagnosis.
BRCA-1 mutation-associated cancer lacks the ovarian site and histology.
Metastatic ovarian cancer captures site and spread but omits serous histology and BRCA1 mutation.
